title: Te Kaiwhakatakoto Kōrero Huna
intro: Ka kitea koe i te aroaro o tētahi tangata whai mana o ngā rā o te whakakitenga. I mōhiotia tēnei tangata mō tōna hinengaro, mō tōna taonga, me tōna mana i roto i tō rātou iwi. I te taenga mai o ngā tohu mārama, i kite rātou i te ataahua, engari i whiriwhiria e rātou te whakakeke i te ngohengohe. He aha te mea i akiaki i tēnei wairua ki te whakatakoto mahere i roto i te pōuri, ā, he aha te mutunga iho?
clues: I manaakitia ahau ki ngā rauemi maha me te mana nui, ā, i taimaha ai taku kupu i roto i ngā whakaminenga.
I te whakahuatanga o ngā kupu a te atua, kāore i taea e au te whakakore i tō rātou pūkenga kōrero, engari kāore tōku whakapehapeha i tuku i ahau kia ngohengohe.
I huihuia e au aku kaitohutohu, ka noho motuhake ahau ki te whakaaroaro i tētahi huarahi hei whakahē i te karere.
I muri i taku whakaaroaro roa, ka kī ahau he 'makutu tuku iho mai i ngā rā o mua' hei pana i te iwi.
Kātahi ka puta te whakakitenga ki ahau: 'Waiho ahau me te mea i hanga e au.' I tohua ahau mō taku mahi tinihanga.
Kāore e roa, ka hopukia tōku rae e te ahi i whakatūpatotia ai ahau, ā, kāore he mawhiti mōku.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I whakatakoto mahere hei kōhuru i te Poropiti
I ārahi i tētahi whakahē i ngā Mahometa
I huihuia he kaunihera hei tohu i te Quran he makutu
I whakatakoto mahere kia peia te Poropiti i Makkah
I whakakahore ki te tohatoha i ana taonga ki ngā pani
trial.answer: I huihuia he kaunihera hei tohu i te Quran he makutu

outcome.label: Hua
options: I ripeneta ia, ā, i tahuri ki te Ihirama
I pāngia ia e te mate kino
I mate ia i te pakanga ki ngā Mahometa
I whiua ia ki te Ahi Reinga
outcome.answer: I whiua ia ki te Ahi Reinga
